content: Ye Dɑfidi u tɔkɔ kuɑ, yerɑ u win bii Sɑlomɔɔ kuɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ.
Mɑ u Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ mɛnnɑ.
Mɑ bɑ Lefibɑ ɡɑrɑ tiɑ tiɑ be bɑ wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ mɔ, kɑ be bɑ kere mɛ. Mɑ ben ɡeerɑ kuɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (38.000).

Mɑ Dɑfidi u tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ nnɛ (24.000) ɡɔsɑ be sɔɔ, be bɑ ko n dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee ten bɑnɑ nɔni doke, kɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ (6.000) be bɑ koo tɔmbu kpɑrɑ, kpɑ bɑ n dɑ bu sirie.

U mɑɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nnɛ (4.000) ɡɔsɑ be bɑ tie sɔɔ, bɑ n dɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten kɔnnɔsu kɔ̃su, kpɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nnɛ (4.000) be bɑ tie bɑ n dɑ Yinni Gusunɔ tɔmɛ kɑ dwee yɑ̃ɑ ni wi, Dɑfidi u derɑ bɑ kuɑ bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ.
Mɑ u bu bɔnu kuɑ wuu wuukɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɛɛsɔni kɑ Kehɑti kɑ Mɛrɑri, Lefin bibun bwese kɛri sɔɔ.
Gɛɛsɔnin bibɑ Lɑdɑni kɑ Simɛi.
Bibu itɑwɑ Lɑdɑni u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Yehiɛli kɑ Setɑmu kɑ Yoɛli. Yehiɛliwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ben ɡbiikoo.
Bibu itɑwɑ Simɛi u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Selomiti kɑ Hɑsiɛli kɑ Hɑrɑni. Berɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Lɑdɑnin bwese kɛrɑn wiruɡibu.
Simɛi u mɑɑ bibu nnɛ ɡɑbu mɑrɑ. Berɑ Yɑsɑti kɑ Sinɑ kɑ Yeusi kɑ Beriɑ.
Yɑsɑtiwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ben ɡbiikoo. Mɑ Sinɑ u sɑ̃ɑ yiruse. Yeusi kɑ Beriɑ bɑ ǹ bibu mɑrɑ n dɑbi. Mɑ bɑ bu ɡɑrisi bwese kɛri tiɑ.
Bibu nnɛwɑ Kehɑti u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Amurɑmu kɑ Yisehɑri kɑ Heboroni kɑ Usiɛli.

Amurɑmun bibɑ Aroni kɑ Mɔwisi. Mɑ bɑ Aroni kɑ win bibun bweseru ɡɔsɑ bɑ yi nɛnɛm sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ bɑ n dɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokeye, kpɑ bɑ n dɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑrun sɔmburu ko, kpɑ bɑ n dɑ mɑɑ tɔmbu domɑru kue kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru.
Adɑmɑ bɑ Mɔwisi Gusunɔn sɔm kowon bibu ɡɑrisiwɑ Lefin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ.
Mɔwisin bibɑ, Gɛɛsɔmu kɑ Ɛliesɛɛ.
Gɛɛsɔmun bii ɡbiikoowɑ Sebuɛli.
Ɛliesɛɛn biiwɑ Rehɑbiɑ. Bii turo win biru u ǹ mɑɑ ɡoo mɑrɑ. Adɑmɑ Rehɑbiɑ u bibu mɑrɑ bɑ dɑbi.
Yisehɑrin bii ɡbiikoowɑ Selomiti.
Bibu nnɛwɑ Heboroni u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Yeriyɑ kɑ Amɑriɑ kɑ Yɑsiɛli kɑ Yekɑmɛɑmu.
Bibu yiruwɑ Usiɛli u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Misee kɑ Yisiyɑ.
Mɛrɑrin bibɑ Mɑkili kɑ Musi. Mɑkilin bibɑ mɑɑ Eleɑsɑɑ kɑ Kisi.
Eleɑsɑɑ u ǹ bii tɔn durɔbu mɑrɑ u kɑ ɡu. Bii tɔn kurɔbɑ u mɑrɑ. Berɑ ben mɛro bisibu Kisin bibu bɑ suɑ kurɔbu.
Bibu itɑwɑ Musi u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Mɑkili kɑ Edɛɛ kɑ Yeremɔti.

Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben yɛnun wiruɡibu Lefin bibun bweseru sɔɔ nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ bu tireru doke tiɑ tiɑ, berɑ mi. Berɑ bɑ ko n dɑ sɔmburu ko Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ sɑɑ be bɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndu mɔn di n kɑ dɑ be bɑ mɛ kere.
Domi Dɑfidi u rɑɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u win tɔmbu bɔri yɛndu wɛ̃. Yen biru u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Lefibɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn kuu bekuruɡiru kɑ ten dendi yɑ̃nu sɔɔmɔ.
Dɑfidin yiire dɑ̃ɑki bin biruwɑ bɑ Lefibɑ ɡɑrɑ sɑɑ be bɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndu mɔn di n kɑ ɡirɑri be bɑ kere mɛ.
Bɑ bu dokewɑ Aronin bibun bweserun wuuru sɔɔ bu kɑ sɔmburu ko Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun yɑɑrɑɔ kɑ ten dii sɔsɔ. Berɑ bɑ ko n dɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten dendi yɑ̃nu kpuro dɛɛrɑsie kpɑ bu mɑɑ sɔmɑ ɡɑɑ ko mi.

Berɑ bɑ ko n dɑ pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ ko n dɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yiiye ko, kɑ sere mɑɑ som mɛ bɑ ko n dɑ kɑ kɛ̃nun yɑ̃kunu ko, kɑ pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ ku rɑ seeyɑtiɑ doke, kɑ pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ rɑ wɔ̃ pɛrɛnti sɔɔ, kɑ kirɑ ni bɑ rɑ sɔmɛ. Beyɑ bɑ ko n dɑ yebɑ kpuron kpɑ̃ɑru kɑ yen dɛ̃ɛbun sɑriɑ mɛɛri.
Bɑ ko n dɑ nɛwɑ sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi bururu kɑ yokɑ bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ tɔmɑ, kpɑ bu nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.
Mɛyɑ bɑ ko n dɑ mɑɑ nùn yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kue bɑɑdommɑ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ, kɑ suru kpɑo ù n yɑrɑ, kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ ni nu tiɑ sɔɔ nɡe mɛ nin ɡeerɑ nɛ kɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ nin woodɑ yi.
Berɑ bɑ ko n dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn kuu bekuruɡirun sɔmburu ko, kpɑ Aronin bibun bweseru tu mɑɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔmburu ko.
Yɑ̃ku kowobun wuunu
